briefHtml:
NAV S$10,079,658 - reported -0.55% (stale baseline), recorded +0.20% d/d; yesterday's print restated down to S$10,059,268

  • Biggest mover: silver's hammer reversal - intraday low $38.09 (lowest in over a year) then ~9% round-trip to close up: spot ~$41.12 +0.8%, futures ~$41.68 +2.3%; GDX +3.5%, SILJ +4.3%, SLVP +4.4%; metals flags cleared
  • The one thing: USTR published Section 301 excess-capacity tariffs - Singapore named at up to 20%, China up to 20% (40% alternative), Vietnam 35%, EU/Japan/Korea/Taiwan 15%; proposed not final (comments Jan 5, hearings Jan 25, effect January at earliest). Hot October PCE (3.8% headline, 3.3% core) keeps the Dec 9 hike ~98% priced

Markets

  • US Wed: wild round-trip - Dow +0.33% 50,183 (erased an 1,100pt loss), SPX 7,186 -0.21%, Nasdaq 23,586 -0.62% (was -4.7%); NVDA $149.30 -3.91% (broke $150); ANT +1.1% still below $83 IPO ($74 low); SOXX -0.5%; DELL +0.7%, HPQ +11%; VIX 28.29 (touched 35); 10y ~4.85-4.87% Investopedia
  • Metals: gold futures $3,605 +1.2% ($3,426 low); silver futures $41.68 +2.3%, spot ~$41.12 ($38.09 low - lowest in over a year) Kitco; BTC ~$60,300; WTI $84.10 +2.5%
  • Asia Wed: STI 4,930.83 -0.57% (lowest since May 8 intraday); DBS S$65.44 -1.21%; HSI 21,966 -1.1% (electronic tech -5%: SMIC HK$45.30 -7.5%, Z.AI -14.1%, Lenovo -11.0%); Tencent HK$337.40 -1.2%; Xiaomi HK$26.56 +0.23% after Q3: rev RMB107.2bn -5% y/y, net profit -68% to RMB3.88bn, EV deliveries 100,975 with EV/AI losing RMB3.4bn
  • FX: USDSGD 1.2902; USDCNY ~6.66; USDHKD ~7.84

Flags

  • 4 critical flags (down from 8): SMIC -7.9% (approximately true: actual -7.5%); Tencent -9.5% and Xiaomi -10.5% are six-session windows anchored to 11-17; listed book -3.34% same artefact; recorded NAV +0.20% d/d is the truth
  • Metals flags (silver, GDX, SILJ, SLVP) cleared after Wednesday's reversal. L46.SI Yahoo 404 - 41st session

Insider trades

  • None found for held names in the Nov 19-26 window. The BlackRock/DBS Form 3 (18-Nov broadcast) rolled just outside 7 days - still the reference institutional-supply event on SG banks
  • SGX API still 401 (12th trading day); Wing Tai pause 14 sessions; no HKEX filings for Tencent/SMIC/Xiaomi; US holdings are ETFs

Congress trades

  • House Republican (WY-1), filed 11/23: dozens of back-dated IRA trades - NVDA partial sale (10/14, $1-15K), MSFT sales (7/02, 10/14), ORCL/SNOW/PANW/CRM/NOW sales; buys in MU, TSM (x2), TSLA, NVDA (4/29), PLD, PG, PFE, WM, SO. Net: selling megacap tech, buying memory/foundry/value Unusual Whales
  • Senate Democrat (CT), filed 11/24: private-asset program - multiple buys of MH Four Winds LLC and MH Built to Last LLC interests (10/15-10/28, clips up to $500K-1M); one stock sale: Starling Oncology ($1-15K) Unusual Whales

Trump / policy

  • Section 301 tariffs announced: 14 of 16 investigations affirmative - China up to 20% combined (40% alternative), Singapore up to 20% (10% possible), Vietnam 35% (20% possible), India 25% (17% possible), EU/Japan/Korea/Switzerland/Taiwan 15%; comments due Jan 5, hearings Jan 25, effect January at earliest; China truce expires Jan 10 Yahoo Finance, Wiley
  • China: overcapacity is a false proposition; rare-earth pause extension still lacks written confirmation
  • October PCE hot: headline 3.8% y/y (highest since 2023), core 3.3% vs 3.2% expected; Q3 GDP revised up to 4.3%; Dec 9 hike ~96-98% priced for 25bp TradingKey
  • Huang testifies before Congress next week; Trump (NYP): pardon always an option, he should tell the truth Yahoo Finance
  • US closed Thursday; Friday 1pm ET half-session

Risk

  • Silver line (est., $41.68 x 1.2902): collateral ~S$95,565; loan ~S$56,240; equity ~S$39,325; ratio ~1.70x (from 1.65x) - but Wednesday's $38.09 low marked equity ~S$31.1k at ~1.55x; stress zone tested and held; -$1 silver = -S$2,293 equity
  • Singapore named a tariff target (up to 20%) - overhang on STI exporters, SGD and the SG-rates theme as STI touches its lowest since May; VNM faces a proposed 35% Vietnam rate - highest on the board
  • NVDA below $150 with congressional testimony next week; ANT below $83 IPO; FX ~35% non-SGD (USDHKD ~7.84 peg edge); metals cluster still dominant despite the relief day; L46.SI 404 41st session; NAV restatements continue

Alpha (signals, not advice)

  • Real assets (20%): strongest reversal of the drawdown - silver $38.09 to $41.12 hammer on a hot-PCE day, gold held $3,426 and closed $3,605, miners +3.5-4.4%. Mechanical trigger (2-3-session gold hold above ~$3,500 through PCE + holiday): session one in the books; Friday's half-session and Monday complete the count. Silver line gets nothing
  • AI bottlenecks (15%, 0% deployed): NVDA closed below the $150-155 zone ($149.30), ANT below IPO, VIX 28 - the zone is being traded through, not just approached; Huang testimony next week is the binary. Tranche stays parked until a 2-3-session base or post-FOMC clarity
  • Defense (15%): 10y fell to ~4.85-4.87% on the safety bid - the 5.20% gate is 33-35bp away and receding; TLT stays gated AT 5.20% only; a risk-off bond rally is not the entry

trumpWatch.title: Section 301 excess-capacity tariffs announced - Singapore named at up to 20%
trumpWatch.detail: USTR affirmative determinations in 14 of 16 investigations (Mexico, Norway excepted). China up to 20% combined (40% alternative if talks fail), Singapore up to 20% (10% possible), Vietnam 35% (20% possible), India 25% (17% possible), EU/Japan/Korea/Switzerland/Taiwan 15%, Bangladesh/Cambodia/Indonesia/Malaysia/Thailand up to 18%; Brazil +10% on sugar/aircraft. Proposed not final: comments due Jan 5 2027, hearings Jan 25, effect 'probably January at the earliest' - the China truce expires Jan 10.

trumpWatch.title: October PCE hot; Q3 GDP revised up to 4.3%; Dec hike ~98% priced
trumpWatch.detail: PCE headline 3.8% y/y - highest since 2023; core 3.3% vs 3.2% expected. Q3 GDP second estimate revised from 3.4% to 4.3% annualized. CME FedWatch ~96-98% for a 25bp Dec 9 hike.

trumpWatch.title: China rejects overcapacity charges; rare-earth extension unconfirmed in writing
trumpWatch.detail: China's Foreign Ministry: 'the so-called issue of overcapacity is a false proposition, and China opposes using it as a pretext for political manipulation.' Tuesday's reported rare-earth export-control pause extension still lacks written confirmation.

trumpWatch.title: Huang to testify before Congress next week; Trump floats pardon
trumpWatch.detail: Jensen Huang appears before congressional committees next week over the scandal that briefly ousted him. Trump (NY Post): a pardon is 'always an option' but he does not think it will be necessary; Huang should 'tell the truth'. NVDA closed below $150 at $149.30, -3.91%.

trumpWatch.title: Metals hammer reversal on hot-PCE day
trumpWatch.detail: Silver printed $38.09 intraday - lowest in over a year - then reversed ~9% to close up (spot ~$41.12 +0.8%, futures ~$41.68 +2.3%); gold futures $3,605 +1.2% off a $3,426 low; miners GDX +3.5% / SILJ +4.3% / SLVP +4.4%. First session of the mechanical stabilisation trigger.
